verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Grok Bot runs on a vendor-hosted 'persistent cloud computer', and the Linux .deb/.rpm/AppImage packages are client apps. Local-desktop execution and routing egress through the desktop are optional add-ons, not a way to self-host the core service, and nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted deployment.
